stem: An alarm was acknowledged and cleared, but the root cause was not established. What should the shift handoff say?
choices: State the alarm, evidence, checks completed and that cause remains unresolved with required follow-up
Delete the alarm because it cleared
Insert the most likely cause as confirmed
rationale: State the alarm, evidence, checks completed and that cause remains unresolved with required follow-up. This preserves the measurement, data-quality, record or role-boundary principle being assessed.
